LTTH Version 1.3.36 Release Notes

Version 1.3.36 completes the WebGPU Fireworks particle rocket finale and publishes all current local improvements.

- NEW: Recognizable Boykisser particle rockets render in small cues and as a large Superfan Hero finale
- NEW: Rainbow and trans-color special rockets add Pride trails and finale accents
- FIXED: Star, ring, standard, and special rockets keep visible headroom instead of clipping at the top edge
- FIXED: Fireworks command admission, GPU resource handling, finale retries, and older-overlay fallbacks are hardened
- NEW: Emoji Rain supports dynamic commands and command-specific despawn timing
- IMPROVED: Coinbattle, Connect Four audio, Viewer Profiles, Music Bot status, and localized guides are refreshed
- NEW: Schnorrbecher repeated gifts fall individually through the opening with a bundled glass impact sound
- IMPROVED: Public release metadata and download surfaces advanced to 1.3.36
